about: Ribbon tooltips: one plain sentence per .uno command saying what it does, shown under the bold "Name (Shortcut)" line. "descriptions" serve every app, "app_descriptions" override them in one app (writer, calc, impress, draw). A ribbon button whose .ui has an hst-ribbon-description line keeps that line. "except" lists ribbon commands that deliberately have no sentence (reason: commands). Vietnamese with full diacritics, at most 90 characters, ending with a full stop; English is the msgid. Generate the patch with scripts/patches/generate-ribbon-tooltips.py; tests/unit/test_ribbon_tooltips.py checks coverage.
